meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a healthy server when available and linking to official server setup guidance when needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Mattermost 机器人接进聊天频道,复用可用服务器并给出搭建指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你团队用 Mattermost,想让机器人常驻聊天频道。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team runs Mattermost and wants a bot living in its channels.

howto.what: Claude 会带你接入 Mattermost 机器人频道：探测或由你指定服务器地址、设置 SiteURL、创建并认证 bot token、配置审批卡片回调，最后构建、测试、重启并验证连通。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude 通过 Mattermost 收发消息，或想添加一个 Mattermost 机器人频道时，它会接管并逐步引导完成接入。

say.text: 帮我接入一个 Mattermost 机器人频道
say.note: 会先探测本机是否已有可用的 Mattermost 服务器
把它作为选定的基础地址（需含协议、不带结尾斜杠）

say.text: 我的 Mattermost 用户名是 alice
say.note: 解析该用户，并打开它与机器人的私信

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through adding a Mattermost bot channel: it finds or you pick a server URL, sets SiteURL, creates and authenticates a bot token, configures approval-card callbacks, then builds, tests, restarts and verifies.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want Claude to send and receive messages over Mattermost, or to add a Mattermost bot channel.

say_en.text: Add a Mattermost bot channel for me
say_en.note: It first probes for an existing healthy server
This becomes the chosen base URL
It resolves that user and opens the DM with the bot
